title: What's <g>Inside</g> My
AI Ops System
subtitle: One folder, eight rooms. Everything has one place to live.

cards.name: brain/
cards.body: My taste: good and bad examples, guidelines, scoring.

cards.name: nodes/
cards.body: One room per job, each with its own playbooks.

cards.name: clients/
cards.body: One space per client. Their rules win there.

cards.name: ledger/
cards.body: The shared memory every room reads and writes.

cards.name: apps/portal/
cards.body: The windows: my inbox and each client's page.

cards.name: schedules/
cards.body: The timers, off until a room passes its tests.

cards.name: tests/
cards.body: Golden cases. A playbook only changes if they pass.

cards.name: brand/
cards.body: This look, in code. Every visual comes from here.
